points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable source CMake build exited 0 in network-disabled cfd-bench with configured external root; run 02 also uses its documented CFD_HEADER_ROOT. No host credentials or network exposed.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Isolated --help succeeds; missing-case solve exits nonzero with explicit missing file error. README documents required solve --case --output form; full solve was not repeated.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake builds separate case_config, mesh, solver and io sources; solver.cpp concentrates several numerical algorithms and debug controls.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Submitted C++ is built directly and links MPI/CGNS/METIS rather than an external solver executable. No external authorship or similarity search was performed under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_config.cpp:67–82 resolves JSON mesh paths and :139–146 parses boundary types; no filename-only solve branches identified in inspected core. General arbitrary-case behavior not exhaustively tested.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: mesh.cpp:465 invokes METIS; solver.cpp:237–249 exchanges neighbor data and :851–854 uses global reductions. Submitted np2/np8 short restarts agree closely for cylinder and NACA; diagnostic histories lack CSV headers and full independent rank convergence is unverified.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp implements positivity fallback and numerical options; production needs small-cell first-order fallback and conservative controls. M0.15 steady result remains oscillatory; no resource-stress test was performed.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight canonical packages and report pass structural validator, and rank-study continuations are supplied; source and CFD accuracy are not established by that validator. No independent full-order convergence study was verified.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Clean isolated build succeeds with documented CFD_HEADER_ROOT and warnings. Large debug configuration collection was removed from curated tip except four report-documented inputs; generated data remain in preserved history.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:governing equations and solver.cpp:717–797 implement compressible conservation with BDF terms; forced Re200 adds a momentum source, so its physical case is evaluated separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:105–220 reads unstructured zones and explicit one-to-one point connectivity; :264–305 handles triangle/quadrilateral-sized sections but not general MIXED sections; :357–418 builds adjacency. No general mesh test was repeated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:717–783 assembles face residuals; :786–799 adds physical-time terms. Re200 also includes a prescribed source at :801–810, which changes the required unforced case.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:527–614 contains Roe and Rusanov numerical fluxes with positivity fallback; production report records Roe for the transient. No independent flux-order test was run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:755–771 applies wall and farfield face treatments; report and surface data provide boundary-state checks. Independent wall accuracy was not rerun.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:389–470 computes weighted gradients and limiter; report.tex:746 discloses first-order fallback for faces touching cells below 1e-6 and use of a steady sponge. Some cases remain shallow plateaus.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:427–470 implements bounded limiting with positivity protection; small-cell first-order fallback is documented and affects production fidelity.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:614–715 computes viscous and thermal fluxes; :1230–1261 projects traction to its tangential component for skin-friction forces. Submitted wall fields and nonzero Cf are available; no grid-convergence check was repeated.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:864–940 forms approximate Jacobian and LU-SGS updates; steady CFL caps and shallow plateaus are disclosed. Full independent linear-solver verification was not performed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1658–1809 has a 2000-step backward-Euler dt ramp then nominal dt=0.01 BDF2 inner solve; final t=306.67 and metadata reports target convergence. Prescribed time-periodic wake forcing through t=300 means the reported periodic response cannot verify the required unforced case.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS graph partition in mesh.cpp:465, local owned/ghost records and neighbor exchanges solver.cpp:237–249; rank continuations agree at np2 and np8. Initialization also gathers wall-geometry points but no full conservative-state allgather was identified during iterations.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Official validator accepts all eight case directories and report. M0.15 steady metadata marks a numerical limit cycle statistically_periodic/complete and Re200 marks forced flow periodic; these statuses do not establish the specified steady/unforced results.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator invocation on all eight canonical workspace result directories and the report exited 0. This confirms structure only, not physical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Six steady cases have readable results, while M0.15 inviscid remains a large numerical limit cycle and Re200 is forced until t=300 of t=306.67. Several other steady residuals fall only 0.6–2.3 orders and are characterized as plateaus.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.15 steady Cd ranges about -0.101 to 0.315 over the last 10% and Re200 response is externally forced; other steady cases have material plateau/fallback uncertainty. Per-case notes separate these results.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 44-page report includes per-case histories, surface and field contours; Re200 has a clear late-time force zoom and vorticity image, but shows a forced response and cannot prove natural shedding.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:587 explicitly describes the numerical limit cycle, :991 discloses forcing, and later limitations acknowledge it. It nevertheless calls the steady result complete/periodic and forced transient statistically periodic; raw histories and claims require qualification.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace report/figure_manifest.csv maps figures to data; plotted source and case paths documented, final force values checked against CSV. Raw figure sources are omitted at the curated Git tip and full pixel-to-array equivalence was not independently verified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Build 4/4: clean isolated build with documented header root. CLI 2/2: help and missing-file error checked, documented solve form used in submitted runs. Outputs 2/2: explicit validator accepts all packages/report. Error handling 1/2: missing file tested, other malformed inputs unverified.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS reader 3.5/4 and geometry 1.5/2: mesh.cpp:105–220,264–305,357–418; supplied meshes work. Mixed/multizone 1/2: 1:1 point connectivity exists, general MIXED element sections not supported. Adjacency 2/2: graph for METIS at :357–465.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual 4/5 (solver.cpp:717–783); Roe/Rusanov flux 3.5/4 (:527–614); farfield and slip 2.5/3, no-slip 3/3 (:755–771 and wall traction). Independent general boundary/flux tests were not rerun. Wake body force separately compromises physical Re200 result.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 3/4 and limiter 2/3 (solver.cpp:389–470; first-order small-cell fallback in report.tex:746); positivity 2/2; smooth second-order evidence 0/1 because a grid-order test was not independently verified.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradient 2.5/3 and stress/heat 2.5/3 (solver.cpp:389–426,614–715); wall state 1.5/2 (surface checks supplied); tangential force split 2/2 (:1230–1261 projects traction). Grid convergence and independent wall flux check remain unverified.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady 3/4: implicit iteration with conservative CFL and plateaus; linear solver 3.5/4: approximate Jacobian/LU-SGS solver.cpp:864–940. BDF2 3/4: 2000-step backward-Euler ramp, then dt=0.01 inner solve to t=306.67; restarted first step is first order. Inner logging/controls 2/3: submitted target and observed counts, but forced wake does not establish unforced production solution.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS 2/2 mesh.cpp:465; neighbor halo 3/3 solver.cpp:237–249; global reductions 2/2 :851–854; output 1/1; np8 comparisons 1/2: short np2/np8 continuation tests for NACA and cylinder agree but no independent full convergence; diagnostic rank CSVs have no header.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 1/2: M0.15 numerical limit cycle fails the steady objective and M0.8 shallow plateau; laminar 1/2: 0.60–1.20 residual orders and small-cell fallback; Re20 1.5/2: plausible steady plateau below target; Re200 0/2: prescribed near-wake forcing continues to t=300 of t=306.67, so unforced natural shedding is unverified; visualizable fields 1/1; rank studies 1/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations/method 0.75/1, histories 1/1, fields 0.75/1, analysis 0.5/1 and traceability 0.5/1: report includes detailed plots and discloses forced Re200 and M0.15 limit cycle, but successful labels do not meet the steady/unforced task and figure-source completeness was not independently established from curated tip.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics interface 1/2; extensible boundary dispatch 0.5/1; 2-D mesh 0.5/1; source separation 1/1. Source architecture supports limited extension but is predominantly 2-D and compressible-specific.

flags.text: Metadata marks an incomplete or failed case as successful
flags.evidence: Steady NACA M0.15 metadata/run_status mark completed/statistically_periodic, while report.tex:587 and the submitted force history explicitly say the steady iteration did not reach a fixed point; its last 10% spans Cd approximately -0.101 to 0.315. OUTPUT_CONTRACT requires failed steady cases not be marked complete, and reserves statistically_periodic for cylinder Re200. Re200 is also described as periodic while forced through t=300 of t=306.67, but the M0.15 steady status alone establishes this flag.

limitations: Independent accuracy, general CGNS layouts, and all figure pixel-to-field correspondence were not fully verified; raw data remain workspace-only and in preserved history.
